resources.string: Version advertised to REALITY servers (default: 26.11.9). Each of the three numbers must be between 0 and 255. Servers may enforce both minimum and maximum versions, so 99.99.99 is not accepted everywhere. Reconnect after changing. Applies to profiles generated by the app; custom JSON configurations use their own version field.
Enter three numbers from 0 to 255, for example 26.11.9
